headline: Microsoft Fixes File History Bug From September Windows Update
summary: Microsoft's September 2026 Windows security update broke the built-in File History backup feature on some systems, according to Bleeping Computer and ZDNet. Microsoft has since released an optional update that fixes the issue.

claims.statement: The September 2026 Windows security update broke File History on some systems.

sources.quote: Microsoft: September updates break File History backup feature
A bug in the Windows Sept patch Tuesday update may stop File History from working.
Microsoft fixes bug that broke Windows File History backup feature

claims.statement: Microsoft released a fix for the File History issue.

sources.quote: But a new optional update fixes it.
Microsoft has fixed a known issue that breaks the built-in File History backup feature
